changelog: - **Dragging a bend point or drawing a frame ends cleanly when the window loses the pointer.** If the window lost focus or was hidden mid-drag (or a bend point lost its hold on the pointer), a dragged bend point stayed where it was, changed with no Undo entry, and could move again when the pointer next passed over it; a frame being drawn with the Frame tool kept growing as the pointer moved. Both now stop as a frame move already did: the bend point goes back and nothing is recorded, and the frame being drawn is dropped with the Frame tool still on.
